brief:
Israeli occupation forces damaged two Palestinian vehicles after their military vehicles struck them in Tulkarm, the Shehab Wire agency reported. The collisions occurred during operations by occupation forces in the West Bank city.

The incident resulted in material damage to both vehicles. No immediate reports specified the severity of damage sustained or whether any occupants were injured in the collisions. The circumstances that led to the vehicles striking one another were not detailed in initial accounts of the incident.
